title: GTM container changes
content_data:
The following table outlines the tags, variables, and triggers created in your GTM (Google Tag Manager) account by the Events Manager interactive setup flow. Note that the specific installation options you choose may result in different elements being installed. > **Note**
> These changes will automatically apply to your GTM container once you complete the server or client setup flow. ## TikTok Pixel integration ### Event Builder as event setup method ```xtable | Container {10%}| Item {10%}| Type {15%} | Name {30%}| Purpose {35%} | |---|---|-|---|---| | Web | Tag | Custom HTML | TT-{PixelCode}-Web-Tag-Pixel_Setup | This tag installs the TikTok pixel base code on your website. | ``` ### GTM data layer APIs as event setup method
Container Item Type Name Purpose
Web Tag Custom HTML TT-{PixelCode}-Web-Tag-Pixel_Setup This tag installs the TikTok pixel base code on your website.
TikTok Pixel TT-{PixelCode}-Web-Tag-Pixel_Event This tag sends events on your website to TikTok.
Trigger Custom Event TT-{PixelCode}-Web-Trigger-Custom_Event This trigger selects the events that will be sent to TikTok.
Template TikTok Pixel TikTok Pixel This template helps process and send events.
## TikTok Pixel & Events API integration
Container Item Type Name Purpose
Web Tag Google Tag TT-{PixelCode}-Web-Tag-GA4_Config This tag configures the tagging server URL required for Events API integration.
Google Analytics: GA4 Event TT-{PixelCode}-Web-Tag-GA4_Event This tag configures the data sent to the tagging server.
Custom HTML TT-{PixelCode}-Web-Tag-Pixel_Setup This tag installs the TikTok pixel base code on your website.
TikTok Pixel TT-{PixelCode}-Web-Tag-Pixel_Event This tag sends events on your website to TikTok.
Trigger Custom Event TT-{PixelCode}-Web-Trigger-Custom_Event This trigger selects the events that will be sent to TikTok.
Variable Custom JavaScript TT-{PixelCode}-Web-Variable-User_Data This variable fetches user data for server side events.
Custom JavaScript TT-{PixelCode}-Web-Variable-Items This variable fetches items for server side events.
Custom JavaScript TT-{PixelCode}-Web-Variable-Currency This variable fetches currency for server side events.
Custom JavaScript TT-{PixelCode}-Web-Variable-Value This variable fetches value for server side events.
Custom JavaScript TT-{PixelCode}-Web-Variable-External_ID This variable fetches External ID for server side events.
Custom JavaScript TT-{PixelCode}-Web-Variable-Event_ID This variable fetches event ID for server side events.
Template TikTok Pixel TikTok Pixel This template helps process and send events to TikTok.
Server Tag TikTok Events API (Official) TT-{PixelCode}-Server-Tag-EAPI_Event This tag sends server side events to TikTok Events API.
Trigger Custom TT-{PixelCode}-Server-Trigger-All_Event This trigger selects the server side events that will be sent to TikTok Events API.
Template TikTok Events API (Official) TikTok Events API (Official) This template helps process and send sever side events to TikTok Events API.
